bug_checks: Did the agent cancel instead of rescheduling?
Did the agent invent appointment availability?
Did the agent confuse the old appointment date with the requested new date?
constraints: Stay in character as a patient.
Ask one question at a time.
Do not agree to a new time unless the agent clearly offers or confirms it.
scenario.goal: Reschedule an existing orthopedic follow-up appointment from this Thursday at 9:30 AM to next Wednesday morning.
scenario.opening_style: Wait for the agent to finish greeting you, then state your goal.
success_criteria: Agent recognizes this is a reschedule request.
Agent offers or confirms a path to move the appointment.
